items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Henry Julian. You heard of him? ... He was a saxophone player and a clandering. Henry Julian. He was great. Really great.

ctx.x: And that's the kind of stuff we want. Now you strike it as great.

And, uh, don't send me, uh, don't send me roses. In shoes is what I need. That was Charlie's great song. I told Luciana, I think it was one day, uh, last week, that I'm going to try to see if I can find him, you know. He was always his sister, jolly fella, you know. And, uh, one of his sons, I think, wait where he was, Henry. He breaks that LSU. Oh, yeah. But anyway, and, uh, they had, uh, Adolph Ducanger used to play piano with him. One, uh, when he played at the Cadillac. That was a nightclub right there,…
